title: EP 5 — SLASH COMMANDS
sub: Turn your best prompts into one-keystroke team shortcuts
lines: Stop re-typing the same prompt every day
Tired of pasting the same prompt every single day?
In Clawd Code, just type a slash, and your shortcuts appear.
Built ins like, slash review, slash resume, and slash clear, are ready instantly.
But the real win, is saving your own, in dot Clawd slash commands.
One markdown file, becomes one reusable command, for your whole team.
Drop in dollar ARGUMENTS, and you can pass a test name straight through.
Now type slash test, and your saved prompt fires, in one keystroke.
Your best prompts, shared and versioned
Your best workflows get committed to git, shared, and run by everyone.
